author: Ankit
problem: Times are 'HH:MM' strings on a 24-hour clock. Return how many minutes from now until the alarm next goes off.
bug_description: Doesn't wrap around midnight, so an alarm time earlier than now gives a negative number instead of the time until tomorrow's alarm.

comments.accurate: Minutes from now until the alarm next rings
comments.wrong_behavior: Minutes from now until the alarm time today; negative if that time has already passed
comments.wrong_location: Time arithmetic verified; check that 'HH:MM' strings are split into hours then minutes
